registered_before: any P5-N2 or ECHT-N2 simulation is scored; no P5-N2 fit quality has been seen
purpose: Decide which omitted electron-impact processes must be added to the N2/N reaction set before it may be called complete for validation. Evaluated from cross sections only, without reference to any fit quality.

default.basis: upper limit = tightest verified table (dissociation_N2, 45 eV mean energy); above it is outside the N2 validation domain, not absorbed into the audit

vibrational_excitation.basis: vibrational losses concentrate at low energy

rotational_excitation.basis: bounded over the low-energy window; implemented only if it crosses the rule

fractions.F_P: k_omit(Te) dE_omit / sum_j k_j(Te) dE_j: share of total electron inelastic power
fractions.F_ion: nu_ions,omit k_omit(Te) / sum_j nu_ions,j k_j(Te): share of total positive-ion production (ionizing channels only)
fractions.F_S_s: share of the production or destruction of a particular modeled species s due to the omitted channel

rule: Promote the omitted process if F_P > 0.01 OR F_ion > 0.01 OR F_S_s > 0.05 anywhere in its applicable Te domain.
denominators: sum over the best currently available complete set of included processes. Any evaluation made before the 8 electronic-excitation and the vibrational channels are available is PROVISIONAL and must be repeated once they are in place.

1_required_before_scoring: N2 electronic excitation (A, B, W, B', a, a', w, C)

status_rule: PINNED.toml [reaction_set] status stays INCOMPLETE until every tier-2 and tier-3 process has a final (non-provisional) verdict under this rule.
